integrity: A self-contained Taylor proof and a reproducible exact symbolic checker are supplied; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact coefficient is optimized only among normalized real four-mode perturbations with the specified powers of the small parameter.
No unrestricted Dirichlet-space sixth-order lower bound or infinite-dimensional optimality is claimed.
The normal-form calculation uses the published sharp inequality as context and does not reproduce its global proof.
Historical priority of specialized higher-order stability expansions remains subject to further bibliographic verification.
title: A four-frequency sextic normal form near sharp Chang–Marshall extremizers
